titolo: SUV a rate da 45.000 euro: quanto costa DAVVERO in 5 anni
protagonista: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, wearing a navy blue polo shirt and beige chino trousers

copertina.sfondo: Marco in navy polo shirt standing proudly next to a new shiny mid-size SUV in a car dealership showroom, shocked expression, bright lighting

scene.voce: Marco compra un SUV nuovo. Prezzo: quarantacinquemila euro. A rate, comodo. Ma quanto gli costa davvero?

sfondi.descr: Marco in navy polo shirt and beige chinos smiling next to a brand new shiny mid-size SUV in a bright Italian car dealership showroom, price tag on the windshield
Close-up of Marco in navy polo shirt holding a price tag reading 45.000 euro in front of a new SUV in a dealership, curious worried expression

scene.voce: In cinque anni paga cinquantatremila euro di rate con interessi. Cinquemila di assicurazione. Ottomila di benzina. Milleottocento di bollo. Tremilacinquecento tra tagliandi e gomme. Duemila di parcheggi e pedaggi.

sfondi.descr: Close-up of a bank loan contract with monthly installments table and a pen on a wooden desk, Italian documents, no people, no cars
Car insurance policy papers and car keys on a kitchen table, Italian insurance document, no people, no cars
Close-up of a gasoline pump nozzle with the display showing liters and euros at an Italian gas station, no people, no cars
Italian vehicle road tax payment slip (bollettino del bollo auto) and a pen on a table, no people, no cars
Tools and new tires stacked in a car repair workshop, service invoice on a workbench, no people, no cars
Italian parking meter on a city street with coins and a motorway toll ticket, no people, no cars

scene.voce: Intanto il SUV perde valore. Oggi vale quarantacinquemila euro. Dopo cinque anni, ventunomila.

sfondi.descr: Marco in navy polo shirt and beige chinos next to a brand new shiny mid-size SUV outdoors on a sunny Italian street, proud smile
Marco in navy polo shirt and beige chinos next to the same mid-size SUV now five years old with small scratches and dull paint, outdoors, sad resigned look

scene.voce: Totale pagato: settantatremilatrecento euro. Rivendita: ventunomila. Costo vero: cinquantaduemilatrecento euro. Fanno ottocentosettantadue euro al mese. Ventinove euro al giorno.

sfondi.descr: Marco in navy polo shirt sitting at a kitchen table with a calculator, papers and receipts spread out, focused expression
Close-up of Marco in navy polo shirt with a shocked wide-eyed face looking at a calculator in his hand, kitchen background
Open empty wallet with a few coins next to a wall calendar on a table, no people, no cars

scene.voce: Come spendere meno? Compra usato di due anni. Versa un anticipo più alto. E confronta le assicurazioni ogni anno.

sfondi.descr: Marco in navy polo shirt and beige chinos next to a clean two-year-old mid-size SUV at an Italian used car dealership outdoors, thumbs up
Piggy bank with euro banknotes and coins on a table next to a calculator, no people, no cars
Laptop-free desk with several insurance quote brochures spread out and a pen, comparing offers, no people, no cars

scene.voce: E il prossimo? Un amico a quattro zampe. Quanto costa davvero un cane?

sfondi.descr: Cute golden retriever puppy sitting in a cozy Italian living room with a leash and food bowl, no people, no cars
